class.description: This is a tracker which acts as an intermediary between other trackers
This is a tracker which follows a line from the current position to a given goal position using a trapezoidal trajectory with distance along the trajectory as the parameter instead of time.
This is a tracker which follows a line from the current position to a given goal position using min jerk trajectory.
This is a tracker which follows a polynomial trajectory.
This is a tracker which follows a velocity command.
This is a tracker which follows an elliptical trajectory defined by amplitudes and period.
This is a tracker which follows a Lissajous trajectory.
This is a tracker which follows a sum of two Lissajous trajectories.
